notes.title: Important Announcement and Update
notes.notes:
[h2]ANNOUNCEMENT ːsteamthisː[/h2][p]
Hello everyone. Firstly we have an announcement for you,

LockYourDoor has been selected for the Tiny Teams Steam Event, the game will be showcased for 1 hour on [dynamiclink href="https://twitch.tv/yogscast"][/dynamiclink] on 9th August between 11 AM and 2 PM BST. If you’re curious about what the full game will look like, this is your chance to get a glimpse for the first time!

[/p][h2]UPDATE ːsteamthisː[/h2][p]
We’ve been updating the game almost daily. Here’s what has changed since the latest update:
([b]v0.93, v0.94, v0.95 Updates[/b])

-A New Main Monster
-AI can now hear voice chat as well
-Voice Chat has improved greatly
-Walkie Talkie added
-Microphone detection & selection
-Key remapping
-Journal and quest updates
-More sleeping events
-Voodoo item
-A special secret item for lockpicking
-Network optimizations
-Dynamic weather system
-Item respawn algorithm (daily)
-Increased lockpick durability
-Increased stamina recovery

We also plan to add a server list to the game, though it might come a few weeks after launch.
Since we’re focused on developing the full game, we’re unable to update the demo. Thank you for your understanding.

If there’s anything you’d like us to add or change, please let us know. Your feedbacks shape the game.

[b]*The planned release date is October, but it could be a month earlier or later. We'll inform you.*[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45402027/b80e423b554a1323ccaca8123ca5c2f86603dc5e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: v0.9.0 LockYourDoor Update
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Horror Enjoyers! 

Please let us know if there is any translation errors.

[list]
[u]Updates[/u]

[*] Added Chinese, Russian, and Turkish language support.
[*] Players can now interact with doors and drawers using the [E] key. (Most requested feature)
[*] Added brightness adjustment in settings.
[*] Flashlight improved – updated cookie and significantly increased brightness.
[*] Stamina increased by 20% for longer sprints.
[*] Join Game button has been added to the main menu.
[*] Removed sleeping blur effect for clearer visuals.
[*] FPS limit options updated to 60 / 144 / 240.
[*] Added another cross to Demo

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[*] Fixed issue where lockpick would break if the pin angle was nearly equal to the lock's open angle.
[*] Fixed a bug where the monster wouldn’t chase after getting a kill during midnight.
[*] Fixed a bug where players couldn’t sleep in a bed if another player had died there.
[*] Fixed black screen freeze when entering a game.
[*] Fixed issue where players would fall through the world when sleeping.
[*] Fixed bug allowing two players to sleep in the same bed simultaneously.

[/list]
Please keep sharing your feedback.
Thank you for your support, and good luck!

notes.title: v0.8.6 LockYourDoor Demo SteamFest Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45402027/8fb608dc0b07bc8b3a0038f4668f0693993314e1.png[/img]



Hello Everyone,

This update focuses on fixing bugs to enhance your gameplay experience as we work to polish the game as much as possible before SteamFest.

Key Changes:
[list]
[*] Precaching is helpful, but it was causing crashes in certain situations. It is now disabled.
[*] Fixed an issue where player character models would not load.
[*] Doors are now more stable, making it much harder to flip them while dragging.
[*] Door Drag Sensitivity option now functions properly for clients.
[*] Fixed a bug where the monster could instantly kill players on stairs.
[/list]

We are committed to continuously improving the game, so please keep sharing your feedback.

Thank you for your support, and good luck!

notes.title: v0.7.2 LockYourDoor Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45402027/8fb608dc0b07bc8b3a0038f4668f0693993314e1.png[/img]



Hello Everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce the release of the LockYourDoor demo, and we couldn’t be happier with your amazing feedback so far. To make your gameplay experience even better, we’ve implemented some exciting updates and fixes:

[list]
[*] Improved the interaction cursor for a smoother experience.
[*] Resolved the visual bug affecting protectors in Room 8 and Room 9.
[*] Optimized the item pickup radius for better usability.
[*] Added a Discord link to the main menu—join us and share your thoughts!
[*] Reduced the likelihood of triggering traps in the labyrinth for a more balanced challenge.
[/list]


We’re committed to enhancing your experience, so keep sharing your feedback—it means the world to us!

Thank you for your support, and happy gaming!
